# host_package_aur (Data Source)

Reads local AUR package installation metadata from Pacman's database without
managing the package. Local lookup reports installation status, installed
version, and install reason and does not require an AUR helper or network
access.

Set `include_remote = true` to query the candidate version through a verified
`yay` or `paru` executable. The helper must already be installed and owned by
its matching Pacman package. When a `host_aur_helper` resource bootstraps the
helper in the same apply, add an explicit `depends_on` to the data source.

> **Security:** Remote AUR metadata comes from user-contributed package
> repositories. This data source does not build or execute a `PKGBUILD`, but
> configurations should not treat AUR metadata as a source-code audit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "host_package_aur" "wl_kbptr" {
  name = "wl-kbptr"

  # Local installation metadata does not require an AUR helper.
  # Set this to true to query the candidate version through yay or paru.
  include_remote = false
}

output "aur_wl_kbptr_installed_version" {
  value = data.host_package_aur.wl_kbptr.installed_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) AUR package name.

### Optional

- `include_remote` (Boolean) Query a verified `yay` or `paru` helper for the candidate AUR version. Defaults to false so local installation metadata can be read without a helper or network access.

### Read-Only

- `candidate_version` (String) Latest package version reported by the AUR helper. Null when `include_remote` is false or no candidate is available.
- `id` (String) Package identifier, equal to `name`.
- `install_reason` (String) Observed Pacman install reason: `explicit` or `dependency`. Null when the package is not installed.
- `installed` (Boolean) Whether Pacman reports the package as installed.
- `installed_version` (String) Installed package version from the local Pacman database. Null when the package is not installed.
